title: Duplicate charge on an invoice, refund escalated
notes: Escalation path. Exercises a dissatisfied sentiment, an escalated status, and a follow-up routed to a named department. All names and references are synthetic.
transcript: Speaker 1: Thank you for calling SSM Repak, this is Sophie. How can I help?
Speaker 2: Hi, this is Daniel Brouwer. I've been charged twice for the same invoice and I'm not happy about it.
Speaker 1: I'm sorry about that, Daniel. Do you have the invoice number to hand?
Speaker 2: Yes, it's INV-90233. I was charged 149 euros on the third and again on the fifth.
Speaker 1: Let me check the billing record... I can see both transactions against that invoice, so you're right, there's a duplicate charge.
Speaker 2: So can you refund it now?
Speaker 1: I'm not able to authorise the refund directly. Duplicate-charge refunds have to be approved by the billing team, so I'll raise a case and escalate it to them today.
Speaker 2: How long will that take? This is money I need back.
Speaker 1: The billing team usually processes these within three to five working days. I'll note it as urgent. Can I take a phone number for the update?
Speaker 1: Got it. I've logged the duplicate charge and escalated the refund to the billing team. They'll contact you on that number once it's processed.
Speaker 2: Fine. I'd just like it sorted.
